pages.scan: I opened works/auto-6294ee8a2094/workflow/storyboards-unnumbered/page-07.png with Read and looked at it myself. At that point I had read only the request JSON. I had not read the source, script, workflow.json, guides or earlier responses. Reading left to right, top to bottom: (1) Top full-width tier: a large rounded balloon at upper left reads 'Welbuk Health is designed to help patients stay connected with their care.' Its tail points right to the grey box labelled 'meera'. A second grey box labelled 'ravi' sits to the right and has no balloon, so it is a silent listener in this beat. The lower half of the tier is empty. (2) Middle-left panel: a balloon at upper left reads 'So I can keep useful information in one place?' Its tail points right to a tall box labelled 'ravi'. Below the balloon, a teal label box flush with the left panel border reads 'WELBUK HEALTH / for patients'. I read it after the question, as a product label. (3) Middle-right panel: a balloon across the top reads 'That's the idea. Let's walk through what is available to you.' Its tail points down to the box labelled 'meera'. A 'ravi' marker dot sits at the far right edge with no box, and its name text runs past the panel border. (4) Bottom full-width tier: a rectangular caption at upper left reads 'A smoother visit. A more connected experience.' Small boxes labelled 'anany' (clipped name) and 'meera' are at lower centre-left, and a 'ravi' box is at upper right. None has dialogue, so this is a silent closing beat. Page number '7' is at the bottom centre.
pages.observation: Each tier holds one balloon or caption, so the order is unambiguous: Meera explains, then Ravi asks, then Meera answers, then the caption. Each question gets an answer that is not skipped: Ravi's 'So I can...?' is answered by 'That's the idea.' The middle tier is two panels side by side, and the left one clearly comes first. The two balloons are far enough apart that a reader will not jump from the first tier straight to the right-hand panel. Each tail points to the intended speaker box: tier 1 to meera, middle-left to ravi, middle-right down to meera. The 'WELBUK HEALTH for patients' label sits directly under Ravi's balloon. It reads as a sign or label rather than speech, and it touches the left panel border. In the right-hand panel, Ravi has only a marker at the edge and his name label crosses the panel border. That is a layout artefact. The bottom tier jumps from 'Let's walk through...' to a closing caption with no transition text. The walkthrough itself is skipped, and only the caption bridges the time and place change. No text is illegible. The tier-4 placeholder name is clipped to 'anany'.
